scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.vercel-build: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run seed -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
